assumptions_and_gaps.description: Expose the existing capture API through a trusted CoreContext contribution observation port bound at preparation. Implement performed reviews only; no spec body edits or fabricated human declarations. All captures require independently observed host events, including declared identities.

limitations: No production host adapter or live host certification: automated ports are deterministic test doubles.
Create/edit contribution capture remains unsupported pending body-change authorization.
Atomic contributor-summary and event-trailer commit integration remains unsupported; any pending capture prevents recording rather than being lost.
Inspection requires an available same-process preparation and request ID; committed-history queries and cross-process recovery remain unsupported.
Evidence paths currently support contained repository artifacts, not a public API for arbitrary private host evidence paths.
No managed plan/spec/ADR lifecycle approval or completion; workflow recording step 04 remains partial.
No power-loss durability or hostile concurrent parent-directory replacement claim.
